sources.title: Microsoft FY2026 Q4 Earnings Conference Call

items.label: Total debt
items.fact_text: Microsoft reported total debt of $40.294 billion at June 30, 2026.

items.label: Net debt
items.fact_text: Microsoft reported $20.935 billion of cash, $55.908 billion of short-term investments, and $40.294 billion of total debt.
items.calculation_method: Total debt minus cash and cash equivalents minus short-term investments.
items.caveat: Short-term investments are treated as cash-like.
items.interpretation: Approximately $36.5 billion net cash on this definition.

items.label: Microsoft Cloud revenue growth
items.fact_text: Microsoft Cloud revenue grew 27% year over year in Q4 FY2026 to $59.3 billion.

items.label: Commercial RPO growth
items.fact_text: Commercial remaining performance obligation reached $678 billion and grew 84% year over year.
items.caveat: Microsoft said RPO growth was 25% excluding OpenAI.
items.interpretation: Headline backlog growth has material customer-concentration effects.

items.label: Microsoft Cloud revenue / total revenue
items.fact_text: FY2026 Microsoft Cloud revenue was $214.4 billion versus total revenue of $331.8 billion.
items.calculation_method: Microsoft Cloud revenue divided by total revenue.
items.caveat: This is not the same as recurring-revenue mix.

items.label: Recurring revenue mix
items.fact_text: The reviewed primary sources do not disclose one company-wide recurring-revenue percentage.
items.caveat: Do not substitute Microsoft Cloud revenue mix for recurring-revenue mix.

items.label: Forward P/E
items.fact_text: The reviewed primary-source set does not provide a full-year forward EPS denominator suitable for forward P/E.
items.caveat: Keep forward P/E unavailable until a clearly sourced consensus or guidance denominator exists.
